Package com.robojacks.lib.hal

Interface GpsIO

All Known Implementing Classes:
SimHardware.SimGps
public interface GpsIO
V5 GPS Sensor, in the sensor's own units: meters from the field center and a compass heading (degrees, clockwise, 0 = toward the field's +Y wall). Robot code uses VexGps, which converts to the library's convention.

      double getErrorMeters()

    • setOffset

      void setOffset(double xMeters, double yMeters)
      The sensor's own built-in offset (VEX's convention: x to the robot's right, y to its front). VexGps sets it to 0 and does the mounting math itself in WPILib's robot frame.

    • declareMounting

      default void declareMounting(Transform2d robotToGps)
      Tells the hardware layer how the robot code says the sensor is mounted. The real brain ignores it; the simulator uses it as the sensor's physical mounting (unless the sim script sets a different one), so simulated readings match the robot code.
